svg.text: v0.3 · DRAFT · both ships shown · net labels (+12V, +5V, GND) join wherever they appear · values pending bench test are marked TBD
C2 10 µF + C3 100 nF, VIN to GND at the pin
1. Relays: 12V optocoupler modules. Trigger polarity is TBD (bench test). R9–R12 hold each relay OFF while the Nano resets:
fit to GND if relays are active HIGH (shown), or to +5V if they turn out active LOW.
2. Limit switches shown normally open: at limit = closed = LOW. Unverified until the bench test. Pull-up and filter sit at the Nano end.
3. A4 (D18) is also the I2C SDA pin. No I2C is used; keep it that way while it drives Relay 2A.
4. Each motor: C8/C9 100 nF ceramic + D1/D2 P6KE18CA bidirectional TVS across its terminals, soldered at the motor.
5. Relay contacts: NO → +12V, NC → GND. Relays off, or Nano reset / power lost = both motor leads at GND (stopped). Wrong direction: swap the motor leads.
6. Every GND symbol is one common ground. Grey analog pins are spare, left unconnected.
